beats.label: The research
beats.text: Scientists tracked **cardiolipin,** a fat inside your cells' **power** **plants.**
beats.note: Finger, Gerhart-Hines et al., Nature Aging 2026 (Univ. of Copenhagen)

beats.label: With age
beats.text: Cardiolipin **drops** in aging muscle, in **mice** and in **humans.**

beats.label: Then
beats.text: Muscle shifts from **fast,** powerful fibers to **slow,** endurance ones.

beats.label: Why it might happen
beats.text: The lead author calls it muscle **trading** **power** for **protection.**

beats.label: The surprise
beats.text: In mice, **antioxidants** made muscles fare **worse,** not better.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: The cause and the fix were shown in **mice.** **No** proven treatment for everyday muscle aging **yet.**
Follow for **aging** science, minus the hype.
